science.explanation: The Psychotronic Amplifier Array v2 is a novel electronic device designed to amplify and manipulate psychotronic signals. This project leverages advancements in electronics and signal processing to create a cutting-edge tool for researchers and engineers.
assumptions: The existence of psychotronic signals, which are assumed to be a real phenomenon.
The ability to detect and measure these signals using conventional electronic equipment.
